title: Registry signature
description: Detached signature of a registry (registry.yaml.sig.json). serial only goes up: a cell refuses a registry with a lower serial than the one it holds, and a different registry with the same serial.

registry_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the registry document.

key.description: owners.root for owner:root, one of owners.ops for owner:ops.

signature.description: Over the canonical JSON of this document without signature.
